messages:
Priya (CTO): Thanks again for joining the all-hands. Leaving a short Q&A thread about the org changes and hiring plan — drop questions and we'll follow up in-thread.
Liz (People Ops): Will answer most hiring/process questions, happy to take mobility questions offline too.
Sam (Eng Manager): Quick one — how many headcount are we moving from platform to runtime vs new hires?
Priya (CTO): Good Q. We're reallocating 6 existing roles to Runtime, and adding 10 net-new hires across Infra and Dedicated this quarter. The goal: reduce cross-team handoffs for low-level infra.
Devin (Product): Timeline? When do team owners change and will product roadmaps be re-synced?
Priya (CTO): Ownership handoff begins next sprint (2 weeks). Product managers will get updated ownership docs + a sync with the affected ENG MANAGERS. Expect replay notes in Confluence by Fri.
Alex (SWE): For folks who are moved, is leveling preserved or re-eval? I heard some ICs got re-leveled?
Liz (People Ops): Leveling is preserved by default. If a role's scope changes materially, managers will discuss leveling with the individual before any change. No surprise re-levels without a 1:1.
Katie (Recruiter): On the hires — public reqs live now: Infra (REQ-892), Dedicated (REQ-899). If you're referring candidates, please use the internal referral form: https://intra.redwood/refer and mark the req ID.
Alex (SWE): Any changes to oncall distribution for the runtime team post-shuffle?
Sam (Eng Manager): We'll keep oncall bandwidth roughly same. A couple of infra engineers will move to runtime oncall rota; ops still owns region failover tasks. We'll publish new rota next Wed.
Devin (Product): How does this impact career growth — will there be new IC ladders for Runtime specialists?
Liz (People Ops): We're piloting a "Runtime Specialist" career path (IC-focused) — leveling guidance will be posted next week. If you want early input, DM me and we can loop you into the rubric review.
Priya (CTO): Also: for teams affected by headcount shifts, we will run 1:1 manager -> all-hands in those teams this week to answer role-specific questions.
Alex (SWE): Cool. For internal transfers, what's the formal process?
Liz (People Ops): Internal mobility: fill the short form, get a manager signoff, and then recruiter loops in. Link: https://intra.redwood/internal-mobility. Hiring freeze? No — transfers + approved new hires proceed.
Katie (Recruiter): Note on offer velocity: we expect faster closures for Dedicated candidates (higher priority). If you have candidate leads, ping me directly.
Devin (Product): Will this trigger changes to team OKRs mid-quarter?
Priya (CTO): We'll minimize mid-quarter scope changes. Any OKR shifts will be scoped to what we can reasonably deliver; PM leads will notify stakeholders if a change is needed.
Sam (Eng Manager): Are managers expected to reallocate budget for contractors vs hires?
Liz (People Ops): Budget owners will get a short budget memo today — managers can request reallocation with justification to finance.
Allhands Bot: Recording uploaded: https://intra.redwood/all-hands/1719754321/recording :white_check_mark:
Alex (SWE): Thanks — appreciate the clarity.
Priya (CTO): Thanks everyone. If you have private questions, reach out to Liz or your manager. We'll keep this thread open for the rest of the day.
